issues.explanation: The project mandates test-first development and requires every implemented behaviour to ship with a Pest/PHPUnit test, but this change adds none for the mention logic or the 1800-character truncation-with-mention case.
The 'Keep docs in sync' convention requires a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] for user-visible changes such as the new DISCORD_MENTION_ID setting, and it is missing.
Removing the blank line after `if (is_array($value)) {` in safe() is an unrelated formatting edit that adds noise to the diff.

In PCRE `$` also matches before a trailing newline, so `\z` (or the `D` modifier) would be stricter; it is not exploitable here because trim() already runs first, but the anchor is looser than intended.

review.summary: The change adds a DISCORD_MENTION_ID setting, validates it as a 17-20 digit snowflake, appends `<@id>` on its own line within the 1800-character budget, and documents the env var in .env.example and both ops docs — the implementation covers every task requirement and the invalid-input cases. It is blocked by the total absence of tests, which this project requires for every implemented behaviour and which the rubric scores as untested; a missing CHANGELOG entry and two small diff nits are the other findings.
